claims.text: How Does the USA Compare on Bank Capital?
claims.support: United States value is 9.174% (9.2%), ranked 69 out of 147.
Indicator: Bank capital to assets ratio (%)

claims.text: Comparing bank capital to assets ratios across major economies using World Bank data.
claims.support: Source: World Bank (IMF Financial Soundness Indicators), 147 entities.

claims.text: The USA has a 9.2% bank capital ratio, while Tajikistan has 20.9%.
That puts America right next to the global median of 9.1%.
This evaluates financial strength by comparing core capital to total assets.
claims.support: Definition: compares Tier 1 capital (core capital) to total assets.

claims.text: In Asia, India has 8.5%, while China has 7.8%.
Further down, Canada has 4.9%, Nigeria 4.5%, and Japan 4.1%.
At the world's bottom, Equatorial Guinea drops below zero, down 6.4%.
How strong are bank capital buffers in your country?
claims.support: Closing question about bank capital buffers.
